title: Burnham 632 New Listing! Downtown Nash Jade Suite!
description:
Great affordable one bedroom  apartment less then 20 min walk to Broadway. Fitness center. Great cozy place and very cost efficient given the crazy hotel prices in Nashville. You’ll enjoy your stay!

You will have access to the entire apartment by yourselves! And all of the complex amenities! Fitness center, pool is heated and opened year around!

The space
Smack in the heart of the city- this suite is central to Nashville’s biggest landmarks, like Vanderbilt, the Parthenon & Centennial Park. Hop on a Bird scooter or grab a VERY short cab ride to Midtown & Broadway- known for the best Honky Tonks and some of the best nightlife in the country! Old & historic, the suite is adorned with records and music decor to make your stay authentic. It's been known to house songwriters coming to the city to work with some of the world's most talented musicians.

You have the entire space to yourself and your group!

You have access to Pool, free parking for one car with 8’6” of clearance. 

Smoking always result in a $250 fine- no questions asked.

Walk. Uber. Lyft. Bike. Taxi. options to explore Nashville

Guest access
The apartment has an open concept that really helps you spread out and settle in to your Music City experience! The kitchen is fully equipped with everything you'll need, bathroom is stocked with plenty of linens & toiletries and of course we provide additional blankets/linens for a comfortable night's rest! The space is perfectly suited for comfortably hosting 2-6 guests (depending on how cozy ya want to be) Our guests really enjoy the unique comfy memory foam queen bed, converter sofa, and stylish décor highlighted with records from some of Nashville's greatest contributors to the music scene that has helped make Nashville the destination city it is!
